note: Image Class adds a 'Class' textfield to the image, responsive_image, media_thumbnail and media_responsive_thumbnail field FORMATTERS via hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form(). The space-separated value is stored at third_party_settings.image_class.class on the field's component inside a core.entity_view_display config entity, and hook_preprocess_field() merges it into #item_attributes['class'] on the rendered . No configure route (configure=null), no settings form, no permissions, no plugins. Medium cases create image field(s) on Article and set the class so an agent can read it back; hard cases require the agent to add/target the class on a live entity_view_display and are verified against it.

evals.prompt: The image_class Drupal module lets me add a CSS class to images. There is no settings page for it - how do I actually set a class for an image field, and where is that value stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the bundle's Manage display, use the Image (or Responsive image / Media thumbnail) formatter, click its cog, and enter space-separated classes in 'Class'. It is stored as a third-party setting on the field's display component: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.image_class.class.

evals.prompt: On which field formatters does the image_class module add its 'Class' option?
evals.expected_output: Only the image, responsive_image, media_thumbnail and media_responsive_thumbnail formatters (image_class checks the plugin id in hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form()).

evals.prompt: When I enter multiple classes for an image field with the image_class module, how are they applied to the rendered markup, and are any existing classes lost?
evals.expected_output: hook_preprocess_field() splits the class string on spaces and merges it with any classes already on the item, writing the result to #item_attributes['class'] so they land on the . Existing classes are preserved (merged, not replaced).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an image field field_ic_known whose Image formatter has CSS classes added via the image_class module. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me exactly which class(es) are set.
evals.expected_output: field_ic_known's component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default has third_party_settings.image_class.class = 'ic-rounded ic-shadow'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two image fields, field_ic_on and field_ic_off. Exactly one of them has a CSS class added through the image_class module. Inspect the live display configuration and state which field has an image_class class (and its value).
evals.expected_output: field_ic_on has third_party_settings.image_class.class = 'ic-hero' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default; field_ic_off has no image_class setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field field_ic_task shown with the Image formatter on the default view mode. Using the image_class module, add the CSS class 'img-fluid' to that image field's rendered output. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set third_party_settings.image_class.class on field_ic_task's component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to include 'img-fluid' (via Manage display's Class field, or by editing the entity_view_display component).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article image field field_ic_teaser is displayed in both the default and the Teaser view modes. Using the image_class module, make it so that ONLY in the Teaser display the image gets the CSS class 'teaser-thumb'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.teaser (the Teaser view mode, not default) set field_ic_teaser's third_party_settings.image_class.class to include 'teaser-thumb'.
